alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 7 at 1:17PM PST until November 8 at 4:00AM PST by NWS Seattle WA
alerts.areaDesc: San Juan County; Lowlands of Western Whatcom County; Lowlands of Western Skagit and Northwestern Snohomish Counties; Downtown Everett / Marysville Area; Shoreline / Lynnwood / South Everett Area; Eastside; City of Seattle; Lowlands of Pierce and Southern King Counties; Port Townsend Area; Island County
alerts.description:
* WHAT...South winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts 45 to 50 mph expected.

* WHERE...Island County, Lowlands of Western Skagit and Northwestern
Snohomish Counties, Lowlands of Western Whatcom County, Port
Townsend Area, San Juan County, City of Seattle, Downtown Everett /
Marysville Area, Eastside, Lowlands of Pierce and Southern King
Counties, and Shoreline / Lynnwood / South Everett Area.

* WHEN...From 6 PM this evening to 4 AM PST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
alerts.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
